svg.title: K1.2 capacitive cell: exact sensing stack and placement
svg.desc: Six separate custom compression capacitors use a grounded steel plate, silicone posts and a covered flexible electrode with a driven shield. The readout is remote from the contact surface.

g.text: K1.2 · the capacitor is on the finger
CH0 + CH1 on the nail prongs · CH2–CH5 on four curved TPU saddles
Schematic cross-section; exaggerated spacing. Dimensions are manufacturing targets.
0.10 mm nail / 0.20 mm TPU · vented retaining skirt
Two separate edge bonds: ground drive + health return
0.15 mm high posts on a 0.05 mm base · open air gaps
Top covered copper: CIN electrode + guard
100 µm PI core · back copper = driven SHLD
Complete flex: 0.186 mm · SHLD is not ground
Original nail or conforming rigid TPU saddle
Four separate stop quadrants: 76.2 µm Kapton + nominal 50 µm adhesive.
Nominal free travel: 73.8 µm. Measure each assembled gap; keep vents and ground ports clear.
FDC1004DGSR reads capacitance at the bank board. Physical force calibration is required.
